value_gloss.broken_overlapping: a broken Line of Fate whose second portion begins before the first leaves off (Cheiro, 'Language of the Hand', p105, line ~1113) -- the self-repairing break, distinct from a clean 'broken'. Denotes a complete change in life, not merely loss.

change_log.author: chat, awaiting Sulabh validation
change_log.change: Add relation attributes 'Convergence' and 'Convergence_Location' (Pattern C, symmetric two-line convergence). Pure relation attributes: value=null, relation_target drawn from relation_target_registry, matched via palm_rules_table match()'s existing targets channel. Symmetry handled by CANONICALIZATION at extraction time (owner = alphabetically-first feature of the pair, target = the other). Convergence = 'line A meets line B'; Convergence_Location (single generic slot) = a third landmark associated with that convergence (either the meeting point or a shared continuation landmark, e.g. F025b fate+heart ascend Jupiter) -- disambiguated in claim prose, NOT structurally split, because vision (gpt-4o) reliability on meet-at vs continue-to is below floor; all location-gated C rules carry a LOWER-CONFIDENCE flag. Registry-legal only -- NOT yet in any vision-prompt menu, extractor label map, or rule file; unreachable until STEP 2 (extractor) and STEP 3 (vision) wiring. attribute_value_binding deliberately UNTOUCHED.
change_log.canonical_owner_rule: For any convergence pair {A, B}, owner = min(A, B) by string sort, relation_target = the other. In-scope owners: Line of Fate, Line of Head, Line of Health, Line of Heart. Line of Life is never an owner among in-scope pairs.
change_log.unlocks: Fate F025b (PARKED_RELATION) becomes authorable once STEP 3 lands.

change_log.author: chat, awaiting Sulabh validation
change_log.change: Generalization step 1 (data-only, zero behavior change): add two new top-level blocks. 'relation_types' maps each relational attribute to its parse STRATEGY (directional/proximity/symmetric) -- the closed dispatch set a future generic parser will switch on, replacing today's bespoke per-attribute parse functions (extract_relational_targets, extract_proximity_observations, extract_convergence_targets). 'vision_relational_menus' is the CLOSED per-line target menu (ORIGIN/TERMINATION/CONVERGENCE/CONVERGENCE_LOCATION only -- BRANCHES_TO and PROXIMITY's landmark half validate against the full relation_target_registry, not a per-line closed list, per the block's own '_note' key), transcribed VERBATIM from agent/palm_processor.py's live describe_palm_image prompt (the actual vision-facing source of truth), covering Line of Head/Heart/Fate/Life.
change_log.reconciliation_note: 3-way drift check against scripts/vocab_reachability_scan.py's _VISION_ORIGIN_MENU/_VISION_TERMINATION_MENU found ONE mismatch: the scan's Line of Fate ORIGIN set is missing 'Plain of Mars', which the live prompt offers. The prompt was taken as authoritative for this registry block (it is what vision actually receives); the scan itself is NOT edited by this task -- that drift is fixed when the scan is refactored to derive its menus from this registry block (a future step), not patched ad hoc here. No CONVERGENCE/ CONVERGENCE_LOCATION menu existed anywhere to compare against (scan has no per-line convergence menu at all yet) -- transcribed directly from the prompt with nothing to reconcile.
change_log.no_code_consumes_yet: Both blocks are registry-legal only. No extractor, scan, or rule file reads 'relation_types' or 'vision_relational_menus' as of this commit -- confirmed by this task's own full-suite run (unchanged at the 22-baseline).

change_log.author: chat, awaiting Sulabh validation
change_log.change: Pattern D step 1 (data-only, zero behavior change): add 'relation_cardinality', a new top-level block parallel to 'relation_types', declaring each relational attribute's cardinality as 'single' or 'multi'. 'Convergence' is 'multi' -- a line may converge with several others at once (the 3-way join life+head+heart, currently unrepresentable by the single-valued slot). 'Convergence_Location' stays 'single': the only in-scope multi case (3-way join) carries no location, and F025b (the single-partner case) has exactly one location; per-partner locations are out of scope (flag if a future doctrine needs them). All other relational attributes (Starting_Point/Position/Branching/Proximity) are 'single', matching their current directional/proximity parse behavior.
change_log.no_code_consumes_yet: relation_cardinality is registry-legal only. No extractor, scan, or rule file reads this block as of this commit -- confirmed by this task's own full-suite run (unchanged at the 22-baseline). Note: meta.version bumps 1.7.0 -> 1.8.0, not 1.6.0 -> 1.7.0 as this task's instructing prompt assumed -- the registry had already advanced to 1.7.0 via the prior Generalization step 1 entry above; 1.8.0 is the correct next version.

change_log.author: chat, awaiting Sulabh validation
change_log.change: Generic convergence emission, step 1 (registry + prompt + test, landed atomically -- NOT data-only, see coupling note below): add top-level 'convergence_lines' (['Line of Life','Line of Head','Line of Heart','Line of Fate','Line of Health']) -- the ONE place the convergence-participating line set is declared. vision_relational_menus' per-pair CONVERGENCE literals (Line of Fate->['Line of Heart'], Line of Life->['Line of Health']) are REMOVED -- CONVERGENCE is no longer looked up per line at all; it is derived generically as convergence_lines MINUS the given line, at prompt-build time in agent/palm_processor.py's _menu(). 'Line of Life' removed entirely from vision_relational_menus (it had no other keys once its CONVERGENCE literal was removed). Line of Fate's CONVERGENCE_LOCATION stays scalar, unchanged. New '_convergence_note'/'_location_note' keys document the derivation convention and the scalar-vs-future-list location shape (S98-ratified).
change_log.coupling_note: This registry edit is NOT safely data-only in isolation -- confirmed by direct simulation before landing: agent/palm_processor.py's _menu() does a bare _VISION_RELATIONAL_MENUS[feature]['CONVERGENCE'] lookup, called unconditionally on every _build_description_system_prompt() run (both hands, every live describe_palm_image() call, and at tests/interpretive/test_palm_processor.py's own module-import time). Removing the literals without _menu() growing a CONVERGENCE-specific derivation path raises KeyError immediately -- proven via an in-memory simulation against the live function before this entry was written. This entry therefore lands in the SAME commit as the agent/palm_processor.py and tests/interpretive/test_palm_processor.py changes that add the derivation and update the prompt/tests to match -- never split across commits in a way that leaves the prompt build broken.
change_log.prompt_change_note: The vision prompt's CONVERGENCE field itself changes wording (not byte-identical to before this step): Head and Heart gain a CONVERGENCE field for the first time (previously absent); Fate's and Life's CONVERGENCE field wording is generalized to a single uniform template across all four blocks, dropping Fate's old F025b-specific 'ascend together' phrasing from the shared field (that phrasing's substance is preserved on Fate's separate, unchanged CONVERGENCE_LOCATION field). This is an intentional widening, not a regression -- see the palm_processor.py commit for the prompt diff and the reasoning for why 'comma-separated' phrasing was NOT used (extractor accepts repeated per-line CONVERGENCE statements, not a comma-joined value, confirmed by direct test against the live extractor).

vision_relational_menus._note: Only closed per-line menus are listed here: ORIGIN, TERMINATION. CONVERGENCE and CONVERGENCE_LOCATION are NOT listed here -- see '_convergence_note'/'_location_note' below. BRANCHES_TO and the PROXIMITY landmark are also deliberately excluded -- both validate against the full relation_target_registry (an open landmark-name pool shared across every relational line), not a per-line closed list; there is no per-line menu to transcribe for them.

Multi-select (a line may cross several other lines at once -- Pattern D). Not hand-listed per line here; adding a new line to convergence_lines auto-participates with zero further vision-prompt edits. RETIRED for Head/Heart/Fate (typed-relationship arc Step 5d, S99) -- their CONVERGENCE field was removed from the vision prompt in favor of the typed RELATIONSHIP channel; the derivation mechanism itself is untouched, and this menu is still live for Line of Life ONLY (Life has no RELATIONSHIP field, so it still needs this channel).
vision_relational_menus._location_note: RETIRED (typed-relationship arc Step 5d, S99) -- Line of Fate's CONVERGENCE_LOCATION menu (formerly listed above, the single-partner F025b case) was removed along with Fate's CONVERGENCE field, both superseded by the typed RELATIONSHIP channel's own 'at <mount>' clause. No line currently declares a CONVERGENCE_LOCATION menu; kept as a historical pointer in case a future line ever needs one again -- when multi-partner locations are needed, capture as a list index-aligned to the (ordered) partner list -- one location per crossing, same order (ratified S98).
